headline: Executive order creates a White House task force focused on the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles.
what_it_does: This order sets up a White House Task Force on the 2028 Summer Olympics, which will be held in Los Angeles. Based on the title alone, the task force appears meant to coordinate the federal government's role in planning for the Games. No summary was provided, so details about its members, duties, or powers are not available here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies may be asked to take part in or support the task force's planning work for the 2028 Games.
The task force will likely work on federal issues tied to hosting the Games in their region, though specific effects are not described.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 5, 2025; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
